text:
Rhea (PM): Short sync: enterprise customers are asking for a contract-level retention toggle + certified export. Need to decide defaults and minimal acceptance criteria.
Diego (Eng): Agreed. Minimal export: compressed JSONL shards + manifest.json with per-file sha256. Package as .tar.gz.
Mina (Security): Signed manifest required. Use HSM-backed ECDSA signatures and include manifest version and generation time.
Sasha (Legal): Customers want the ability to opt into key-escrow for long-term access. We'll need a clear consent clause and revocation window.
Pri (CS): Pilots want a Console "legal hold" button to pause TTLs and show export progress. Also an audit entry showing who toggled it.
Rhea (PM): Proposed retention defaults: audit_trail=2y, request_meta=1y, payloads=90d. Enterprise add-on: archival up to 7y.
Diego (Eng): Implementation note: tag writes with retention_tier and retain_until. Index metadata for warm queries; full blobs go to cold. Export job streams by tag range, computes checksums, builds manifest, signs it.
Mina (Security): BYOK modes: 1) customer-managed KMS where we never have plaintext; 2) escrow-wrap with explicit consent for archival export. No automatic escrow.
Sasha (Legal): Draft consent language: "Customer consents to Redwood retaining a wrapped copy of the key solely to enable lawful historical exports; revocation requires 30 days' notice and may limit exportability."
Pri (CS): Pilot gating: two customers (fintech + healthcare) must complete end-to-end export and verify signatures. Also need pricing note for long retention.
Rhea (PM): Launch criteria draft: 1) manifest spec published; 2) Console legal-hold toggle + export preview; 3) BYOK escrow flow documented; 4) 2 pilot exports confirmed; 5) runbook and SLOs published.
Diego (Eng): Timeline: RFC + spec this week, alpha (audit logs only) in 6 weeks, pilots with BYOK in 14 weeks, GA in ~20 weeks.
Mina (Security): Action: threat model for escrow + HSM design (due EOW).
Sasha (Legal): Action: consent clause + subpoena/notification playbook (due EOW).
Pri (CS): Action: recruit pilots and collect acceptance criteria (due +7d).
Rhea (PM): Risks: key revocation edge cases, storage cost, emergency legal holds. Mitigations: opt-in escrow, cold tier pricing, dual-approval legal hold.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1w: Follow-up on retention & export deliverable.
